EditAnything.notes: Prefer the existing LTX 2.3 Comfy root. Install BFSNodes only into a root already proven to load the current LTX 2.3 base workflow. Confirmed 2026-08-06: ComfyUI_LTX23's own models/ subdirs are all empty placeholders -- real weights (ltx-2.3-22b-dev, distilled/in-outpainting/clean-plate LoRAs, complete Gemma-3-12B dir) live in <your-shared-models-dir>/ and are only reachable if extra_model_paths.yaml is active; right now only extra_model_paths.yaml.example exists (the .example suffix means it is NOT active unless ComfyUI is launched with an explicit --extra-model-paths-config flag pointing at it). No edit_anything_* weight files exist anywhere in models_shared -- those 6 required Edit Anything model files still need downloading regardless of the path-config fix. BFSNodes is not cloned anywhere on this pod.

FlexAM.notes: Do not install the pinned FlexAM stack into the LTX environment. Reuse only a FlexAM-specific or closely matching Python 3.10 / torch 2.5.1 root.

Ditto.notes: A compatible WanVideoWrapper root is the best fit. The official graph is the low-VRAM quantized/distilled path. ComfyUI_WANVACE (has ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper, VideoHelperSuite, kjnodes, wanvaceadvanced) is the purpose-built VACE root and the recommended target -- confirmed 2026-08-06 that it has none of the required Wan2.1/umt5/Ditto weights staged yet (models/{diffusion_models,vae,text_encoders} are empty placeholders), so this is an install_nodes_or_models_only case, not safe_reuse. Do NOT use ComfyUI_SCAIL2 even though it also matches the node markers: CODE_HANDOVER.md's non-negotiable constraints explicitly bar returning to SCAIL-2 as a comparison path for this shot, and it has no matching model weights either (only an unrelated SCAIL2 relight LoRA) -- the raw scanner score alone will rank it above WANVACE by node-marker overlap, which is why this override exists.

SyncLoRA.notes: No faithful canonical ComfyUI graph is asserted. Prefer an existing official LTX-2 / ltx-pipelines environment.

KiwiEdit.notes: No canonical ComfyUI workflow is asserted. Prefer a dedicated Kiwi environment; do not force its torch/diffusers stack into an existing Comfy root.
